conventions.exception_hierarchy: Sealed class with final subtypes (ApiException pattern)
conventions.error_mapping: PlatformException caught and remapped to domain exceptions
conventions.const_constructors: All stateless classes use const constructor

findings.title: Keyboard hook cleanup not verified in error paths
findings.description: LockdownPlugin destructor now properly nullifies keyboard_hook_ after UnhookWindowsHookEx().
findings.resolution: Added keyboard_hook_ = nullptr; after unhook to prevent double-free and ensure clean state.

findings.title: Platform exception messages lack context for debugging
findings.description: Dart channel classes catch PlatformException and wrap with domain exception, but lose the original exception code (e.g., 'NO_WINDOW', 'HOOK_FAILED'). Only message is preserved.
findings.evidence: throw FullscreenEnforcementException('Failed to enforce fullscreen: ${e.message}') loses e.code ('NO_WINDOW').
findings.impact: Harder to diagnose specific failure modes in production logs (e.g., distinguish 'window not available' from 'SetWindowPos failed').
findings.required_action: ADVISORY: Consider preserving PlatformException.code in LockdownException subtypes if diagnostic value outweighs simplicity. Current approach is acceptable for MVP.

findings.title: EventChannel streams documented but not implemented
findings.description: Dart classes expose violations Stream<String> from EventChannel, and C++ has event_sink_ members, but SendViolationEvent() only logs to OutputDebugString. No actual EventSink wiring.
findings.evidence: void LockdownPlugin::SendViolationEvent(...) { OutputDebugStringA(...); } — no EventSink->Success() call.
findings.impact: Violation streams return empty (no events emitted). Phase 2 acceptance criteria states 'Event streams functional' but implementation is deferred.
findings.required_action: NOTED: Phase file already documents 'EventChannel deferred to Phase 3'. Mark acceptance criteria as 'partial: logging only, EventSink in Phase 3'.

findings.title: Unit tests skipped by user
findings.description: Phase 2 selected 'tests: no' at Step 0.5 checkpoint. Manual test documentation provided, but no automated Dart unit tests for channel mocks.
findings.evidence: Quality and Testing State: 'Testing: Skipped by user (decision: user_confirmed_skip)'
findings.impact: No regression detection if channel signatures change. Manual testing required before each release.
findings.required_action: NOTED: User confirmed skip. Document in phase completion that automated tests are recommended before Phase 5 (UI integration).

verdict_reason: All blocking findings resolved. 1 LOW advisory (exception context preservation) and 2 NOTED items (EventChannel deferred to Phase 3, unit tests skipped by user).
